the contingency of tit for tat, as in self-control studies, is a powerful determinant of cooperation.
the contingency between behavior of the self and others is an important factor in determining the behavior of the self.
the contingency between cooperation and defection, as imposed by tit-for-tat, is a powerful determinant of the behavior of participants in a five-person multiplayer prisoner's dilemma.

a simple contingency of reinforcement can be effective at increasing cooperation in multiplayer games.
the contingency of reinforcement is a key variable in determining the outcome of a multiplayer prisoner's dilemmas.
